import os
p='/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1790687614/attempts/bd404c7f247c4b47824543a2b5d1e349/system/state/workspace/programs'
os.makedirs(p,exist_ok=True)
f=p+'/task-3fb332d4.py'
code='''def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    bg=grid[0][0]
    colors={v for row in grid for v in row if v!=bg}
    if not colors:
        return out
    mark=next(iter(colors))
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        for c in range(1,len(row)-1):
            if row[c]==bg and row[c-1]==mark and row[c+1]==mark:
                out[r][c]=2
    return out
'''
open(f,'w').write(code)
grid=[[3]*6 for _ in range(5)];grid[2][0]=grid[2][2]=5;grid[4][1]=grid[4][3]=5
ns={};exec(open(f).read(),ns);result=ns['transform'](grid);result
